The '''Caarimon Ministry of Conservation''', also known as the '''Caarimon Conservation Ministry''', was an organization that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Caarimon]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The ministry was responsible for protecting Caarimon's plant life, and the [[Caarite]] [[Nuris Blaht]] was employed by the ministry to greet off-worlders who visited Caarimon.
